release_notes: Conversion attribution fix for affiliate-network postbacks. Restores every layered report (a stray // comment made SQLite reject the campaign_report statement, so Sub1..Sub30, Country, Day and Campaign views all errored out); stamps each postback conversion with its click's campaign, offer, sub_id_1..5, IP and user agent so the conversions log and its campaign/offer filters stop showing unlinked rows; keeps the incoming subid out of the sub1 dimension; matches network status words case-insensitively (an 'Approved' that belonged to no status group is why campaigns could show Conversions: 1 with Sales/Leads/Rejected/Trash all 0) and covers approve/accepted/paid, new/waiting/processing, reject/decline/cancelled and spam/duplicate; attributes CSV-imported conversions as well; migration 33 backfills historical rows from their clicks.
